column1: # one per line: <dir> <owner/repo> <default branch>, separated by tabs or
# spaces; # starts a comment. The one list every tool reads:
#   list-lint-files.sh               skips these dirs (so every lint gate does)
# Each refuses to run if this file is missing, malformed or empty. So that
# a mistaken line can't point the refresh's rsync --delete at docs/ or
# another project directory, a dir must be named <repo>-<branch> (GitHub's
# name for a branch download), and its owner must be on the @owners line
# below -- trusting a new owner is a separate, deliberate edit there. Check
# Upstream renamed it ChrisTitusTech/titstack; GitHub redirects this name.
